randomness_control: Both arms use identical sample-order seeds and a separate augmentation RNG; historical runs keep their original RNG path
comparison_policy: mask_unk for both models; isolates training augmentation
selection: Report prior superiority rule separately. Simplification requires all predefined performance guards and all paired interval noninferiority bounds below.
confirmation: Only if internal simplicity gate passes; identical criterion on three paired full-training seeds; no retuning
scope: Target-input-informed design; fitting/selection uses attachment2 train only; validation confirmation is conditional, not an untouched benchmark; no test evaluation or special labels
budget: Three candidate internal fits using audited reference fits; if simplicity gate passes, six paired full confirmation fits

simplification.interval_rule: Require every two-sided 95% video-bootstrap interval to lie within its one-sided noninferiority margin. Conditional fixed-fit evidence; not training-seed or selection-adjusted.
